title: Material Properties Vocabulary (example constraint schema)
description: EXAMPLE constraint schema — not part of the core LGD schema set. It shows how a producer defines their own governed vocabulary and binds it to a namespace prefix via `context.<prefix>.constraint` (here the `mat` prefix). Like the core vocabulary validators it is keyed on LOCAL names (`density`, not `mat:density`) and validates the de-prefixed, namespace-grouped subset of a node's `metadata`. Unlike the `lod`/`provenance` validators, it exercises the full value-object model: each property is a measured quantity whose `.value` is range-checked AND whose `.unit` is pinned, so a wrong unit, a negative magnitude, or a missing unit is rejected. All properties are optional; additional local names are allowed and not constrained.

density.description: Mass density value object (metadata key `mat:density`). Value in kg/m3, non-negative.

thermalConductivity.description: Thermal conductivity value object (metadata key `mat:thermalConductivity`). Value in W/(m.K), non-negative.

fireRating.description: Fire resistance rating value object (metadata key `mat:fireRating`). Whole minutes, non-negative.

compressiveStrength.description: Characteristic compressive strength value object (metadata key `mat:compressiveStrength`). Value in MPa, non-negative.
